meta.title: Schema and SEO Testing Starter
meta.description: A beginner-friendly WordPress Playground setup for testing CSV-based schema import, URL validation, schema output, and generated PHP code.
meta.author: snehgohil

options.blogdescription: A temporary WordPress site for testing CSV-based schema workflows.

steps.data:
Schema Bulk Import Testing Guide

Use this Playground site to test the complete CSV-based schema workflow.

  1. Install and activate a schema bulk import plugin from this screen.
  2. Open Schema Manager > Dashboard from the WordPress admin menu.
  3. Click Download Sample CSV to download the correctly formatted CSV template.
  4. In Column A, enter the complete page URL, including https:// and the domain.
  5. In Column B, paste the complete JSON-LD schema, including the <script> tags.
  6. Open Schema Manager > Import CSV and upload the completed CSV file.
  7. Review the results. The plugin will show which page URLs were found and which URLs were not found.
  8. Save the valid schemas and open the related website pages to confirm that the schema is being added correctly.
  9. Validate the schema output using a structured-data or schema validation service.
  10. To keep the schema without keeping the importer plugin active, open Schema Manager > Generate Code, copy the generated PHP code, review it, and add it to a child theme or custom functionality plugin.

Note: Review generated PHP code before adding it to a live website. A child theme or custom functionality plugin is safer than editing a parent theme directly.
